edges.reason: Vines on the jungle wall are the only climbable path up to the y=6 platform where acacia logs are stacked
The chest containing jungle planks for crafting stairs is on the same elevated platform as the acacia logs
The birch sign text reads 'Tulip Garden ↑' directing the player north to the flower garden area
The birch sign text reads 'Water Source →' directing the player east to the collectible water pool
The orange banner marks the village entrance; the potato farm is inside the village walls beyond the gate
The armorer villager stands at the edge of the potato farm; finding the farm locates the trader
The birch button is embedded in a polished basalt enclosure; mining surrounding basalt reveals the hidden button
Pressing the birch button opens the iron door gatehouse, the only passage to the village wall with the orange banner
Sugar cane is adjacent to the river crossing; clearing it reveals the stepping stones to the crafting island
The crafting table is on a raised obsidian pillar; water bucket must be placed to create a water elevator to reach it
